Requirement 3.2.3 is deleted from bleeding edge version, but for releasing v4.0.3 it is a breaking change.

v4.0.2-3.2.3:
> Verify the application only stores session tokens in the browser using secure methods such as appropriately secured cookies (see section 3.4) or HTML 5 session storage.

Problems with that are the same like described in #1091 - it allows to store cookie-based session token to sessionStorage.

Proposal for v4.0.3:
> Verify the application only stores session tokens in the browser using secure methods such as appropriately secured cookies for cookie-based session tokens or sessionStorage for token-based session tokens.

For next big release, like 5.0 or 4.1, this requirement is removed.

comments.body: I do not like the idea of reverting a bad requirement, but I do not see a better solution.

it's not reverting, it's taking at least some improvement for v4.0.3 instead of leaving problematic version like it was in v4.0.2.

No revert for future big releases, like it was clearly written in my comment:

> For next big release, like 5.0 or 4.1, this requirement is removed.

I open those issues for future traceability - to have some argumentation and reasoning, why some change was made for v4.0.3.
Change is breaking for v4.0.3, issue closed.
